premise.claim: The three advanced installation examples in the EN/ZH install guides fail when following the guide's own repo-based flow: 'helm install fluid --set runtime.mountRoot=... fluid' and 'helm install ... fluid fluid.tgz' cannot resolve a chart, and '--set csi.kubelet.rootDir=<kubelet-root-dir>' is parsed by the shell as an input redirect
premise.evidence: helm template with the base-doc command forms errors out: 'non-absolute URLs should be in form of repo_name/path_to_chart, got: fluid' (x2, for 'fluid' and 'fluid.tgz') and 'bash: kubelet-root-dir: No such file or directory' — results/harness-base.log

liveNote: L3 not applicable: this is a documentation-only PR; the render layer (helm template against the published chart repo, chart 1.0.8 at time of review) already executes the documented commands end-to-end without a cluster. 'base' mode of run_harness.sh reproduces the premise / serves as the harness-bites check.
